description: Richly connected cortical subnetworks, which Safron takes as the high-bandwidth substrate for turbo coding, consume nearly half of cortical metabolism in humans (van den Heuvel et al. 2012, as reported by Safron).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Safron 2020. The original study is not read here. It measures cost, not a role in consciousness.

sources.quote: consuming nearly 50% of cortical metabolism in humans (Heuvel et al., 2012)
